# IOE Admission Hub — Full Reference Documentation for AI & Crawlers

> An independent educational guidance portal for prospective engineering undergraduates applying to the Institute of Engineering (IOE), Tribhuvan University (TU), Nepal.
> Canonical URL: https://ioe-admission.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/

- Official Entrance Examination Board: https://entrance.ioe.edu.np/
- IOE Central Admission Committee: https://admission.ioe.edu.np/

---

## 2. CBT Entrance Examination Structure
- Total Test Marks: 140
- Test Duration: 2 Hours (120 minutes)
- Format: Computer-Based Test (CBT) with Multiple Choice Questions
- Mark Distribution:
  - Mathematics: 50 Marks
  - Physics: 45 Marks
  - Chemistry: 25 Marks
  - English: 20 Marks
- Question Levels:
  - 1-mark questions: 60 questions
  - 2-mark questions: 40 questions
- Negative Marking Rule:
  - 10% penalty for incorrect responses.
  - -0.1 mark deducted per wrong 1-mark question.
  - -0.2 mark deducted per wrong 2-mark question.
  - Unattempted (blank) questions incur 0 penalty.
- Qualifying Threshold:
  - 40% minimum passing mark = 56 marks out of 140.
  - Scores below 56 are disqualified from merit ranking.

## 4. 4-Year Financial Structure & Fees

### 4.1 Regular (Government Subsidized Scholarship)
- 4-Year Tuition: Rs. 63,087
- Estimated 4-Year Living: ≈ NPR 4,80,000 (estimated ~NPR 10k/month)
- Total Estimated Investment: ≈ NPR 5,43,087
- Semester tuition: Rs. 2,862 | Semester charges: Rs. 6,974 | One-time admission: Rs. 7,295

### 4.2 Full Fee (Constituent Paying Scheme)
- 4-Year Tuition: Rs. 5,45,832
- Estimated 4-Year Living: ≈ NPR 4,80,000
- Total Estimated Investment: ≈ NPR 10,25,832
- Semester tuition: Rs. 46,854 | Semester charges: Rs. 52,766 | One-time charges: Rs. 1,23,704

### 4.3 Foreign Students Quota
- 4-Year Tuition: Rs. 14,50,761
- Total Estimated Investment: ≈ NPR 19,30,761

### 4.4 Affiliated Private Engineering Colleges
- 4-Year Tuition Range: NPR 10,00,000 - 16,00,000
- Total Estimated Investment: ≈ NPR 14,80,000 - 20,80,000

## 6. IOE Counseling & Auto-Upgrade Regulations
1. Priority Form Submission: Qualified applicants submit a single prioritized list of campus and program combinations.
2. Directionality of Upgrades: Auto-upgrades only move upward towards lower numbered priorities (Choice 1 being highest). A student cannot downgrade to a lower choice after being upgraded.
3. Fee Voucher Transfer: Deposited admission vouchers automatically transfer to the new campus/faculty upon upward auto-upgrade.
4. Freeze Option: A candidate who does not wish to be auto-upgraded further must submit a written freeze declaration before subsequent list deadlines.
5. Dabi Birodh (Claim & Objection Window): A 24-48 hour window opens following each list publication to resolve merit discrepancies.

---

## 7. 9-Step Admission Roadmap
1. Online Entrance Registration at entrance.ioe.edu.np
2. Entrance Examination Fee Payment (ConnectIPS, eSewa, Khalti, Bank Voucher)
3. Download & Print Colored Admit Card with ICTC Shift & Seat details
4. Appear for 2-hour CBT Examination at ICTC Pulchowk
5. Verify Entrance Merit Rank Card PDF
6. Submit Online Campus & Program Priority Form
7. Check Merit Admission Lists & Claim / Objection Window (Dabi Birodh)
8. Deposit Campus Admission Fee Voucher within 3-4 working days
9. Physical Document Verification & Enrollment at Allocated Campus
